                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      y(1 - 2k) = k(x + z)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      y = \\(\\frac{k(x + z)}{1 - 2k}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      మూడవ సమీకరణం నుండి:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      z - 2kz = kx + ky

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      z(1 - 2k) = k(x + y)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      z = \\(\\frac{k(x + y)}{1 - 2k}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      x = y = z కాబట్టి, వ్యక్తీకరణలను సమానం చేయండి:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \\(\\frac{k(y + z)}{1 - 2k} = \\frac{k(x + z)}{1 - 2k} = \\frac{k(x + y)}{1 - 2k}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      x = y = z అని అనుకుందాం:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \\(\\frac{2kx}{1 - 2k} = x\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      k కోసం పరిష్కరించడం:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      2kx = x(1 - 2k)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      2k = 1 - 2k

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      4k = 1

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      k = 1/4

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      అందువల్ల, a = 1/4

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      సరైన సమాధానం ఎంపిక 3.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n2c4:T84f,\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      दिलेल्याप्रमाणे:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      a = \\(\\rm \\frac{x}{2x+y+z}=\\frac{y}{x+2y+z}=\\frac{z}{x+y+2z}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      वापरलेले सूत्र:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      समीकरण सोडवण्यासाठी, आपण गुणोत्तरांमध्ये समानता आणि सममितीचा गुणधर्म वापरतो.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      गणना:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      a = \\(\\rm \\frac{x}{2x+y+z}=\\frac{y}{x+2y+z}=\\frac{z}{x+y+2z}\\) = k मानूया.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      तर आपल्याला मिळते:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      x = k(2x+y+z)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      y = k(x+2y+z)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      z = k(x+y+2z)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      प्रत्येक समीकरणाची पुनर्रचना करताना:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      x = 2kx + ky ", "mr": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      दिलेल्याप्रमाणे:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      a = \\(\\rm \\frac{x}{2x+y+z}=\\frac{y}{x+2y+z}=\\frac{z}{x+y+2z}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      वापरलेले सूत्र:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      समीकरण सोडवण्यासाठी, आपण गुणोत्तरांमध्ये समानता आणि सममितीचा गुणधर्म वापरतो.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      गणना:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      a = \\(\\rm \\frac{x}{2x+y+z}=\\frac{y}{x+2y+z}=\\frac{z}{x+y+2z}\\) = k मानूया.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      तर आपल्याला मिळते:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      x = k(2x+y+z)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      y = k(x+2y+z)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      z = k(x+y+2z)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      प्रत्येक समीकरणाची पुनर्रचना करताना:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      x = 2kx + ky + kz

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      y = kx + 2ky + kz

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      z = kx + ky + 2kz

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      पहिल्या समीकरणावरून:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      x - 2kx = ky + kz

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      x(1 - 2k) = k(y + z)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      x = \\(\\frac{k(y + z)}{1 - 2k}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      दुसऱ्या समीकरणावरून:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      y - 2ky = kx + kz

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      y(1 - 2k) = k(x + z)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      y = \\(\\frac{k(x + z)}{1 - 2k}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      तिसऱ्या समीकरणावरून:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      z - 2kz = kx + ky

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      z(1 - 2k) = k(x + y)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      z = \\(\\frac{k(x + y)}{1 - 2k}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      x = y = z असल्यामुळे, पदावली समान करा:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \\(\\frac{k(y + z)}{1 - 2k} = \\frac{k(x + z)}{1 - 2k} = \\frac{k(x + y)}{1 - 2k}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      x = y = z असे गृहीत धरा:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \\(\\frac{2kx}{1 - 2k} = x\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      k साठी सोडवताना:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      2kx = x(1 - 2k)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      2k = 1 - 2k

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      4k = 1

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      k = 1/4

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      अशाप्रकारे, a = 1/4

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      योग्य उत्तर पर्याय 3 आहे.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n2c5:T7f2,\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      প্রদত্ত:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      a = \\(\\rm \\frac{x}{2x+y+z}=\\frac{y}{x+2y+z}=\\frac{z}{x+y+2z}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ব্যবহৃত সূত্র:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      সমীকরণ সমাধান করতে, আমরা অনুপাতের সমতা এবং প্রতিসাম্যের ধর্ম ব্যবহার করি।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      গণনা:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ধরি, a = \\(\\rm \\frac{x}{2x+y+z}=\\frac{y}{x+2y+z}=\\frac{z}{x+y+2z}\\) = k

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      তারপর দেওয়া আছে:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      x = k(2x+y+z)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      y = k(x+2y+z)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      z = k(x+y+2z)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      প্রত", "bn": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      প্রদত্ত:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      a = \\(\\rm \\frac{x}{2x+y+z}=\\frac{y}{x+2y+z}=\\frac{z}{x+y+2z}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ব্যবহৃত সূত্র:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      সমীকরণ সমাধান করতে, আমরা অনুপাতের সমতা এবং প্রতিসাম্যের ধর্ম ব্যবহার করি।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      গণনা:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ধরি, a = \\(\\rm \\frac{x}{2x+y+z}=\\frac{y}{x+2y+z}=\\frac{z}{x+y+2z}\\) = k

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      তারপর দেওয়া আছে:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      x = k(2x+y+z)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      y = k(x+2y+z)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      z = k(x+y+2z)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      প্রতিটি সমীকরণ পুনর্বিন্যাস করে পাই:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n
